description: Issues a new owner link for a client in the batch and invalidates the old one, clearing any earlier claim and approval. Requires the session creator (or an agency owner/admin) and the link's current revision. It sends nothing; the returned link is delivered by whoever re-issued it.

expectedRevision.description: The session revision you last read.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this request; reuse it when retrying the same request.

sessionId.description: The owner's enrollment session to re-issue.

name: agency_enrollment_rotate_owner_link
title: Replace Owner Enrollment Link
